option_relations.rationale: Allergic fungal rhinosinusitis is a condition that causes nasal obstruction and discharge, but it is not directly related to the symptoms of abducens nerve palsy described in the vignette.
The symptoms described in the vignette, such as binocular horizontal diplopia and inability for the left eye to track beyond the midline, are consistent with abducens nerve palsy.
Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps is a condition that causes nasal obstruction and discharge, but it is not directly related to the symptoms of abducens nerve palsy described in the vignette.
Iatrogenic abducens nerve palsy is a type of abducens nerve palsy that is caused by medical intervention, which is consistent with the vignette's description of the condition occurring after surgery.
